children.name: Amphithrax aculeatus
children.description: Amphithrax aculeatus, sometimes referred to as the hairy clinging crab, granulated spider crab or paved clinging crab, is a crab living in saltwater.

children.name: Mithraculus sculptus
children.description: Mithraculus sculptus, the green clinging crab or emerald crab, is a species of crab in the family Majidae.

children.name: Omalacantha bicornuta
children.description: Omalacantha bicornuta, often known as the speck-claw decorator crab, is a species of crab in the family Mithracidae.

children.description: Microphrys weddelli is a species of crab in the family Majidae.
